title: [Dev-i/j] improvement suggestion
symptom: When a user has changed the preference 'deliver this part of bolus wizard result [%]' and tries to do a bolus when CGM signal is missing, the Correction % defaults back to 100%, which may inadvertently cause a low in children or users with varying insulin needs.
cause: The recent change to bolus wizard prevents changing the bolus % when no CGM data is available, defaulting to 100%.
fix: The issue was improved in a commit (cb9935d88014b4b022f7bcddc0f216b18d5105d9), but the specific fix is not described in the thread.
